Sextant's 37 inbound rows (re-recorded in plan 5 Task 6b, which made a blueprint built in one module and imported by another resolve its class; it was 11 rows) are these: 10 at an address the oracle lists (google_oauth 3, `/ping`, `/status.json`, `/setup` GET and POST, `/api/config`, and `/api/admin/queries/outdated` and `/rq_status`); 24 `(unresolved)` rows, one for each of the 24 other oracle pairs (the `org_scoped_rule(...)` routes in `redash/handlers/*.py` and in the auth blueprints (ldap_auth, remote_user_auth, saml_auth), whose path comes from org_scoped_rule(), which branches on settings.MULTI_ORG, a deployment value, so the path is not evaluated; the 12 of them that name a handler name the oracle's handler function, the other 12 name none); and 3 oidc rows (create_oidc_blueprint returns nothing unless OIDC is configured, so the oracle run has none). 10 + 24 = all 34 oracle pairs (28 rules) are read, 24 of them without an address; 34 + 3 = 37.
